summary: Migration Center can generate detailed fit assessment reports locally, including offline use for air-gapped environments.

supporting_pages.title: "Generate an offline assessment \_|\_ Migration Center \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: It provides an overall fit assessment using one of the following scores: Excellent fit Good fit, with some findings that might require attention Needs minimal work before migrating Needs moderate work before migrating Needs major work before migrating No fit Insufficient data You can generate reports in HTML, Microsoft Excel, CSV, and JSON format.
The offline assessment creates reports that provide you with a high-level fit assessment result for migration and potential blockers for different migration journeys.

supporting_pages.title: Generate TCO reports \_|\_ Migration Center \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: You can view your TCO report directly in Migration Center, or export it to Google Slides or Google Sheets, or download it as a CSV file or a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet.
Limitations If you generate a TCO report for a group that contains a database deployment and its underlying server, Migration Center generates separate cost estimates for the server and the database.
